trial_court: Judge, Family Court, Bundi (Rajasthan), Matrimonial Case No. 368/2019
case_name: Smt. Neha Parashar Wife Of Nitish Sharma vs Nitish Sharma S/O Shri Shesh Narayan
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife lodged an FIR against respondent-husband for the offence under Sections 498-A and 406 IPC. Respondent filed an application under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act before the Judge, Family Court, Bundi (Rajasthan) to pressurize and harass the petitioner.

legal_principles.principle: A transfer application under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 can be allowed if there is a sufficient cause.
legal_principles.held: Despite service, no-one has put in appearance on behalf of the respondent. Taking note of the facts and circumstances of this case, it appears that the petitioner has made out a prima facie case for transfer of the matrimonial case to another court.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to appear despite service does not necessarily mean that the transfer application will be rejected.
legal_principles.held: Despite service, no-one has put in appearance on behalf of the respondent. Taking note of the facts and circumstances of this case, it appears that the petitioner has made out a prima facie case for transfer of the matrimonial case to another court.

outcome.final_order: Petition filed under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act pending before the Judge, Family Court, Bundi (Rajasthan) is hereby transferred to the Judge, Family Court Kota (Rajasthan).
